directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an advertisement on your campus website to sell a computer you used at college. Your advertisement may include its brand, specifications/features, condition and price, and your contact information. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Are you in search of a reliable and affordable computer for your college studies? Look no further! I'm selling my well-used Lenovo laptop.

To begin with, this Lenovo computer is a real powerhouse. It's equipped with an Intel Core i5 processor, which ensures smooth multitasking whether you're working on multiple documents, coding, or streaming videos. The 8GB of RAM allows for quick data processing, and the 256GB SSD provides ample storage space for all your files and software.

In addition, the condition of the laptop is excellent. It has been well-maintained with no visible scratches on the body. The screen is clear and sharp, and the keyboard is responsive.

Furthermore, the price is extremely reasonable. I'm offering it for only 2000 yuan, which is a great deal considering its performance and condition.

If you're interested, please contact me at 123456789 via text or call. Don't miss this opportunity to own a high-quality computer at a low price!
